entries.summary: Latent bl-es cold-start bug (missing AwsRegionProvider from ES v1 signing) found, root-caused, fixed with aws-java-sdk-core 1.12.730; QA/PROD run old code, INT dormant.
entries.detail:
LATENT BUG found + fixed in pi-bl-es-lambda (NOT caused by OWASP work; pre-existing on develop, verified by rebuilding jetty-only jar which failed identically). Root cause: bl-es excludes com.amazonaws:aws-java-sdk-core from cloud-sdk-aws; ES SigV4 signing via vc.inreach.aws:aws-signing-request-interceptor:0.0.22 references com.amazonaws.regions.AwsRegionProvider but only drags in aws-java-sdk-core:1.10.19 which lacks that class -> IndexerHandler no-arg ctor (AWS Lambda cold-start entry) throws NoClassDefFoundError: com/amazonaws/regions/AwsRegionProvider. Verified 1.10.19 lacks class, 1.12.730 has it. FIX: added explicit com.amazonaws:aws-java-sdk-core:1.12.730 to pi-bl-es-lambda pom (depth-1 wins over interceptor's 1.10.19). After fix: jar 65MB (was 63.5), AwsRegionProvider present, IndexerHandler() INIT_OK with creds, 93 tests pass.
INVOCATION: bl-es lambda triggered by SQS event-source mapping (Enabled, batchSize 1) from queue inttra_*_sqs_pi_bl_es; handler IndexerHandler::handle. AWS instantiates via no-arg ctor each cold start.
PROD/QA state (acct 642960533737, profile 642960533737_INTTRA2-QATeam): inttra2_qa/pr_lambda_bl_es_stream both run OLD pre-upgrade jar (~104MB, LastModified Jun 1 / Jun 13) and process BL events cleanly today (logs show IndexerHandler running, no AwsRegionProvider error; 'Error in BL ES Delete not_found' is benign app log). INT inttra_int_lambda_bl_es_stream got NEW upgraded jar (66MB) today 09:56 but last invoked Mar 2025 -> latent bug dormant. When ION-16417 upgrade deploys to QA/PROD, bl-es would break at cold start WITHOUT this fix.
